EXPORTS += [
    "nsAutoSyncManager.h",
    "nsAutoSyncState.h",
    "nsImapCore.h",
]

UNIFIED_SOURCES += [
    "nsAutoSyncManager.cpp",
    "nsAutoSyncState.cpp",
    "nsImapFlagAndUidState.cpp",
    "nsImapGenericParser.cpp",
    "nsImapHostSessionList.cpp",
    "nsImapIncomingServer.cpp",
    "nsImapNamespace.cpp",
    "nsImapOfflineDownloader.cpp",
    "nsImapOfflineSync.cpp",
    "nsImapProtocol.cpp",
    "nsImapSearchResults.cpp",
    "nsImapServerResponseParser.cpp",
    "nsImapService.cpp",
    "nsImapStringBundle.cpp",
    "nsImapUndoTxn.cpp",
    "nsImapUrl.cpp",
    "nsImapUtils.cpp",
    "nsSyncRunnableHelpers.cpp",
]

# If this was in UNIFIED_SOURCES, we'd get compile errors on Mac.
SOURCES += [
    "nsImapMailFolder.cpp",
]

FINAL_LIBRARY = "mail"

LOCAL_INCLUDES += [
    # for nsImapProtocol.cpp
    "!/ipc/ipdl/_ipdlheaders",
    "/ipc/chromium/src",
    "/netwerk/base",
]

XPCOM_MANIFESTS += [
    "components.conf",
]
